column1: # Source of truth for building shared/articles.js. Body text comes from
# content/wix-export/<slug>.txt; this file supplies everything around it.
# author "?" = no byline anywhere on the old site. Do NOT invent one — ask the
# club who wrote it, then fill it in here.
# rating: n/max. Blank when the piece isn't a review.
# NOTE: the Wix page "gaming" was a byte-identical duplicate of "blanson-f-c-2-0"
# (both "Blanson beats Victory 4-0") and is deliberately excluded.
# date: the day it ran, as YYYY-MM-DD. Blank for all 41 archived articles -
# the old Wix site never recorded one. Do NOT guess; fill a row in only when
# the club actually knows the date. A blank date simply prints no date.
# topics: what the piece is ABOUT, separated by commas. Sections are one per
# article and describe where it belongs; topics cut across them, so a horror
# game and a horror film sit together. Free text — write it the way it should
# read on the page. Reuse the exact wording of an existing topic to join it;
# the build warns if two spellings would collapse into one address.
